Treated as the same club license/continuation as Brisbane Lions (1997-). This is a documented modelling decision, not an uncontested fact: Brisbane Lions was formed in 1997 by a merger of Brisbane Bears and Fitzroy. AFL Tables and common convention treat Brisbane Lions as the continuing entity of Brisbane Bears. Fitzroy is kept as a SEPARATE canonical team (see 'Fitzroy' row) rather than folded in, since Fitzroy's own 1897-1996 playing history is not conventionally attributed to Brisbane Lions.
